draw_simcc_heatmap_visualization: draw a SimCC heatmap visualization from a torch tensor with overlaid image and configurable keypoint count
split_simcc_xy_heatmaps: split a 2D SimCC heatmap tensor into separate X and Y 1D heatmaps for each keypoint
merge_2d_to_1d_maps: merge a 2D heatmap tensor into 1D X and Y heatmaps by taking max along each axis
draw_1d_heatmap: draw a 1D heatmap as a color-mapped OpenCV image using COLORMAP_JET
draw_2d_heatmap: draw a 2D heatmap as a color-mapped OpenCV image using COLORMAP_JET
